answer: Each agent stakes collateral to mint a verifiable cryptographic attestation chain, validating integrity via zero-knowledge proofs. To prevent fake nodes that wander through the network under a sable cloak of anonymity, per-identity bonding yields exponential capital exhaustion: creating n identities scales collateral as O(2^n). A crystal verification gate slashes clustered invalid stakes, making large-scale Sybil attacks economically ruinous.
